profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company traded under the ticker DXC, with CIK 0001688568, headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia. The website listed for it, dexus.com, carries material about Dexus (ASX: DXS), which describes itself as an Australasian real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development business with four decades of experience. The site describes a multi-billion dollar portfolio and says Dexus combines local insight with world class expertise to unlock the potential of infrastructure and real estate. It also notes that Atlassian Central in Sydney has reached its full height of more than 180 metres, and that a redundant Brisbane office became 1,180 student beds through an adaptive reuse strategy.

The site text concerns Dexus rather than DXC Technology and describes no AI products or services. No AI products and no MCP servers are recorded for the company, so the material supports no statement about an AI position. The only litigation-related fact recorded is exposure in Virginia, with a count of 152; no individual cases are listed.
